events.name: Toronto Tech Week
events.blurb: Largest annual celebration of Canadian tech. Includes ALL IN Talks Toronto and dozens of AI-adjacent founder sessions.

events.name: ALL IN Talks Toronto
events.where: Toronto Tech Week · Vector Institute + Scale AI
events.blurb: One-day flagship during Toronto Tech Week. Presented by Vector Institute, supported by Scale AI — positions Ontario as AI leader. Audience: researchers, engineering leaders, founders, policy.

events.name: Toronto Machine Learning Summit (TMLS)
events.blurb: 10th annual. 15,000+ practitioner community. Three tracks: Research, Business Strategy, Technical Applications. Focused on production ML, RAG, agentic systems, GenAI ops — not slideware. Highest-signal Toronto event for your team.

events.name: 12th Big Data & Analytics Summit Canada
events.blurb: Canada's market-leading enterprise data event. TD, RBC, BMO, Loblaws, Canadian Tire, Stats Canada on the speaker bench. Ten content tracks, dedicated AI stream. ~500 attendees.

events.name: IDC AI & Data Summit Toronto
events.where: Executive · CDO / Head of Data audience
events.blurb: One-day exec format on governance, AIDA compliance, scaling AI.

events.name: AI Tinkerers Toronto
events.blurb: Live code demos, screened audience. Highest signal:noise of any Toronto AI meetup.

events.name: Vector Institute · Remarkable (annual)
events.blurb: Vector's annual flagship showcasing AI research and industry innovation. 2026 edition was Feb 19–20; next edition expected Feb 2027. Add to watchlist.

events.name: AI Tinkerers Ottawa
events.blurb: Builders-only, 3-hour format, lightning code demos (no slides). Part of the 108k-member global network.

events.name: Ottawa Data & AI
events.blurb: Practitioner workshops covering DE, BI, AI, DevOps.

events.name: AI & Tech Networking Ottawa
events.blurb: Pitch-and-investor format. Fast read on the local capital scene.

events.name: Mila Techaide 2026
events.blurb: Hugo Larochelle, Oana Balmau, Natasha Jaques, Ivana Kajic keynote. Proceeds to Centraide.

events.name: After Mila — Community Series
events.blurb: AI researchers paired with field experts to talk real-world impact.

events.name: IVADO Symposium · AI Meets Statistics: Biomedical Data
events.blurb: Academic-industry crossover on biomedical AI methodology. IVADO is the Université de Montréal-led consortium (Polytechnique, HEC, Laval, McGill) — Bengio is scientific director.

events.name: IVADO · The Governance of AI
events.blurb: Four-day thematic program on AI law, regulation, and economic governance. Relevant for navigating AIDA and your data org's policy posture.

events.name: ALL IN AI
events.blurb: 6,500+ attendees, 40 countries. Bengio, Aidan Gomez (Cohere), Kari Briski (NVIDIA). Canadian flagship.

events.name: Montréal AI/ML & Data Drinks
events.blurb: Informal, no-host format. Data Drinks variant runs in May.

events.name: Snowflake Summit 2026
events.blurb: 20,000+ attendees. 500+ sessions. Openflow, Adaptive Compute, Cortex AISQL. Directly relevant to your BQ→Snowflake migration.

events.name: Databricks Data + AI Summit
events.blurb: Delta, Iceberg, Spark, MLflow, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow. DSPy, LangChain, dbt, Trino on agenda.

events.name: dbt Summit (was Coalesce)
events.blurb: Largest gathering of dbt users. Fusion engine, AI features, analytics-engineering playbooks. Most relevant to your stack.

events.name: World Summit AI USA
events.blurb: US edition of the World Summit AI series (Amsterdam parent event). Enterprise + research mix, Bengio/Pineau in past Americas editions.

events.name: AWS re:Invent 2026
events.blurb: Largest cloud + AI conference. 2,200+ sessions. Heavy 2026 themes: agentic AI, Bedrock, AI Factories. Registration opens Jun 16; early-bird saves $1,200 until Aug 25.

events.name: NeurIPS 2026 (Atlanta satellite)
events.blurb: 40th NeurIPS. Main conference in Sydney Dec 6–12; synchronized satellites in Atlanta and Paris Dec 9–13. Foundational AI research event.
